facts.fact: Actus du Bénin reports that article 576 of Benin's Digital Code provides up to five years in prison and a fine up to CFA 25 million for malicious use of editing applications to alter photographs, audio or video.
Actus du Bénin reports that TikToker Fresnel was arrested and held in custody in June 2026 after posting an AI-generated image of former president Patrice Talon.

BEN.note: No government use of AI is stated.
No sectoral AI tool is stated.
No AI model, dataset or computing is stated.
